name: treety-workspace
description: A hierarchical terminal workspace for VS Code and future hosts.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @treety/core run build && pnpm --filter @treety/cli run build && pnpm --filter treety run build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @treety/core run check && pnpm --filter @treety/core run build && pnpm --filter @treety/cli run check && pnpm --filter treety run check
scripts.release:prepare: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm package:core && pnpm package:cli && pnpm package:pre-release
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @treety/core run test && pnpm --filter @treety/cli run test
